mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( order_id, review_content, analysis_status, reply_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{reviewContent}, 'PENDING', 'NONE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json::text AS analysisResultJson, to_char(analyzed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS analyzedAt, reply_content AS replyContent, reply_status AS replyStatus, to_char(replied_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS repliedAt, to_char(reply_updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS replyUpdatedAt, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json::text AS analysisResultJson, to_char(analyzed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS analyzedAt, reply_content AS replyContent, reply_status AS replyStatus, to_char(replied_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS repliedAt, to_char(reply_updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS replyUpdatedAt, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json::text AS analysisResultJson, to_char(analyzed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS analyzedAt, reply_content AS replyContent, reply_status AS replyStatus, to_char(replied_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS repliedAt, to_char(reply_updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS replyUpdatedAt, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM review ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, order_id AS orderId, review_content AS reviewContent, analysis_status AS analysisStatus, analysis_result_json::text AS analysisResultJson, to_char(analyzed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS analyzedAt, reply_content AS replyContent, reply_status AS replyStatus, to_char(replied_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS repliedAt, to_char(reply_updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS replyUpdatedAt, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatedAt FROM review WHERE analysis_status = 'PENDING' OR ( analysis_status = 'FAILED' AND updated_at < #{failedRetryDeadline} ) ORDER BY review_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}

UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'COMPLETED', analysis_result_json = CAST(#{analysisResultJson} AS jsonb), analyzed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'FAILED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET analysis_status = 'PENDING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE analysis_status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < #{processingTimeoutDeadline}

UPDATE review SET reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_status = 'ACTIVE', replied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, reply_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_status = 'ACTIVE', reply_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET reply_content = NULL, reply_status = 'DELETED', reply_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
